column4: cleat#2882: the column-collation live controls are dialect-gated by whichever scratch helper builds their pair, and this job supplies MySQL only. The PostgreSQL case skips at its own postgresAdminDSN() guard -- the guard is required, because scratchPostgresDB has none and FAILS rather than skipping if it is absent, which is what reddened this job on PR #3121's first head. The SQL Server case skips inside mssqlDiffCase's mssqlScratchDB. TWO, measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set, not by delta: go test ./migration/catalogdiff/ -count=1 -json reports exactly these two names and no failures. multi-db-ci.yml:529 supplies all three and runs both for real.

cleat#2882: same pair as the line above, mirrored -- this job supplies SQL Server only, so the PostgreSQL case skips at its postgresAdminDSN() guard and the MySQL case skips inside mysqlDiffCase's mysqlScratchDB. TWO, measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set, and the same first-head regression applies here: without the PostgreSQL guard the package FAILED rather than skipping, which the identical command at the previous head (9a46ba20) reported as ok.

cleat#2882: this job supplies PostgreSQL only, so the two non-PostgreSQL live controls skip inside their scratch helpers. The PostgreSQL case runs here and is NOT declared -- it is the arm this job exists to exercise. TWO, measured by NAME with CLEAT_TEST_DB set and MySQL/SQL Server unset: go test ./migration/catalogdiff/ -count=1 -json reports exactly these two names, no failures.
